about: Fighters whose vanilla colours differ in joint rest values, with vanilla's costume file for each colour, colour 0 first. Costume slot k takes colour k's rest values bit for bit (pokemelee/rest_values.py), so an online opponent on a vanilla disc simulates the fighter as this disc does. A slot past vanilla's colours takes colour 0's, as a vanilla client draws it. Captain Falcon's colours 1-5 differ at the arms and hands (up to about 0.2 units), which are ECB points and carry hitboxes. Elsewhere only Peach 1 and 3 and Pichu 1 differ from colour 0 in a channel an animation can leave unkeyed, by float rounding (about 1e-6); they are not listed.
